title: Runtime Action Interference for AI Control of AlphaStar in StarCraft II
abstract: arXiv:2608.21398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A trained reinforcement learning policy does not determine the complete behavior that users encounter: deployment code still schedules, admits, suppresses, or replaces its proposed actions. We contribute \emph{runtime action interference} (RAI), an AI control mechanism that preserves policy parameters while regulating action pacing and filtering configured action patterns after inference. RAI releases a proposed action only when its cooldown condition is satisfied and its content detector does not flag the action; otherwise, it dispatches a no-op. The detector covers specified toxic behaviors, including worker-unit harassment, while the cooldown controls action rate. We implement RAI in a replication of AlphaStar actor.py and make the implementation and reproducibility materials available through an open source code repository. translated_title: 星际争霸II中AlphaStar的AI控制的运行时动作干扰
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21398v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：训练好的强化学习策略并不能决定用户遇到的完整行为：部署代码仍然会调度、接纳、抑制或替换其提出的动作。我们提出了“运行时动作干扰”（RAI），这是一种AI控制机制，它在保持策略参数的同时，在推理后调节动作节奏并过滤配置的动作模式。RAI仅在冷却条件满足且其内容检测器未标记该动作时才释放提出的动作；否则，它会发送一个无操作。检测器覆盖了指定的有毒行为，包括工人单位骚扰，而冷却机制控制动作速率。我们在AlphaStar的actor.py复现中实现了RAI，并通过开源代码仓库提供了实现和可复现性材料。我们在一个星际争霸II人类参与者研究中部署了RAI，该研究比较了同一策略的两种呈现方式。
tldr: 本文提出一种名为运行时动作干扰（RAI）的AI控制机制，通过冷却和内容过滤在推理后调节动作，在不改变策略参数的情况下抑制有毒行为，并在AlphaStar复现和人类研究中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Runtime Action Interference (RAI), an AI control mechanism that regulates action pacing and filters toxic behaviors after inference while preserving policy parameters, validated in an AlphaStar replication and human study.
